question: Ticket 81eb3e46aed9 touches outline section 5.6, where Q#18 stands open: "Where are instances declared, so the rack knows to build cc 1? Draft: the existence of cairn/devices/<device>/<instance>/ in class-space (CLAUDE.md: one address in two roots)." What is the answer?
why_it_blocks: the ticket works inside outline section 5.6, and the answer to Q#18 may change it
answer: Q#16/Q#18 are answered in the outline (Akien 2026-11-04, commit e340aa98): yes — declared by class-space folders, the rack is only what runs — CairnComponentOutline.txt: "5.7.3.2 It is the shims connected to the bus: who's in the rack is who's connected, which the bus can measure. A shim that isn't running isn't connected, so it isn't in the rack. The rack says what is running; it is not where instances are declared (5.7.3.4)." | "5.7.3.4 An instance is declared by its folder existing in class-space: cairn/devices/<device>/<instance>/ (one address in two roots). Declared = the folders (read by the rack tool, 17.20); running = which of those are in the rack."
